description:
Best crossbreeding layout from a pool of plant clones. The gene calculator's beam search, ported exactly: which clones to plant around the centre, how many of each,
and what the centre will most likely become (with every outcome's chance). Uses the game's gene weights (red
W/X 1.0, green G/Y/H 0.6).

centre.description: Optional genes of the plant in the centre slot (default: unknown).

clones.description: Comma-separated 6-letter gene strings of the clones you have (G Y H W X).

max_neighbours.description: Most neighbouring plants to use (a planter grid allows 8).

target.description: Optional 6-letter target such as GGGGYY; default: as many G and Y as possible.

name: genetics_best_layout
title: Best crossbreeding layout from a pool of plant clones
